summary: A research building at 1700 4th St, opened 2005, home to QB3 (California Institute for Quantitative Biosciences) director's office and central administration, built as a hub for academia-biotech collaboration.

facts.value: Bohlin Cywinski Jackson (corroborated by a former project manager's own portfolio and an architecture-press article, not confirmed directly on a UCSF-owned page)
QB3 director's office and central administration; academia-biotech collaboration space
